proposed_sites.reason: mcp.server.fastmcp module path is removed in v2 and moved to mcp.server.mcpserver; additionally the FastMCP class itself is renamed to MCPServer, so both the import path and the imported identifier must change to `from mcp.server.mcpserver import MCPServer`.
Constructs an instance of the FastMCP class, which no longer exists under that name in v2 — must be changed to MCPServer(...) per the SDK's class rename.
